title: I built a free market intelligence platform for retail traders — options analytics, live ticker, bottleneck scanner (wookofwallstreet.com)
author: ControlNo
selftext:
Hey r/ai_trading —

Tired of watching retail traders pay $300+/month for institutional-grade data, so I built a free alternative.

What's live:  
— Options screener with built-in analytics (Tradier API)  
— Live market ticker with momentum signals  
— Cross-sector bottleneck scanner — flags supply-chain tightness across 18 sectors before it hits headlines  
— Community feed for trades, DD, and market takes  
— News aggregated from multiple sources

All of that's free, no card required, at wookofwallstreet.com. There's also an optional Wook Pass tier at $11.99/mo for personal on-demand scans, saved history, and the options-income playbook — but none of the core tools above are gated behind it.

Want honest feedback from people who actually trade: what's missing, what would make this a daily habit?
